datasetNote: Candidate qualification and environmental test matrix for the six hardware-bearing families (HUB, AIS, WATCH, SENSE, DISPLAY, PILOT). Every test is NOT_EXECUTED: there is no prototype, no laboratory was engaged or contacted, no test was run and no report exists. No IP/temperature/EMC rating, no certification and no qualification claim may be derived from this file. Requirement sources are candidate references only: the standard texts were not purchased/read in this session; only official catalogue or official EU pages were retrieved (see data/evidence/manufacturing.json). IEC 60945 is a voluntary method reference for recreational craft, NOT a legal requirement (see D17 section 2.2). IEC 60529 is a CANDIDATE REQUIREMENT only and defines no MAREA rating. Zero cost evidence: no laboratory was contacted and no public laboratory price was observed, so every estimatedCost is UNKNOWN with amountEur null.

tests.purpose: Establish the emission behaviour of the assembled appliance across conducted (150 kHz-30 MHz) and radiated (30 MHz-6 GHz) ranges so the EMC route for a future wired appliance can be planned.
tests.requirementSource: CISPR 32:2015+A1:2019 emission method (EVD-MC11-410); EMC Directive 2014/30/EU market frame (EVD-MC11-415); IEC 60945:2002 EMC provisions as a VOLUNTARY method reference only (EVD-MC11-401), not a legal requirement for a recreational-craft accessory.
tests.acceptanceCriterion: Candidate: no emission above the limit class chosen at design review (Class A or Class B is a conformity decision, not an engineering default); no configuration-dependent exceedance; margin target to be fixed at design review. Not measured, not achieved.
tests.testMethod: Engineering pre-scan on the first article, then accredited emissions test on a frozen configuration (enclosure, harness, firmware, radio set).
tests.responsibleParty: Accredited EMC laboratory (not engaged) + MAREA hardware engineering (not authorised)

tests.purpose: Establish whether radiated and conducted RF, electrical fast transients, surge and DC dips cause reset, corruption, latch-up or unsafe behaviour on the assembled appliance.
tests.requirementSource: IEC 61000-4-5 surge (EVD-MC11-408); IEC 61000-4-29 DC dips/interruptions (EVD-MC11-409); CISPR 32 frame (EVD-MC11-410); IEC 61000-4-3/-4/-6 named candidate methods whose pages were NOT retrieved in this session; IEC 60945:2002 as voluntary reference (EVD-MC11-401).
tests.acceptanceCriterion: Candidate: no reset, latch-up, data corruption or unsafe state at the agreed levels; performance criterion defined per function at design review; recoverable upset only where explicitly accepted. Not measured, not achieved.
tests.testMethod: Accredited immunity campaign: radiated RF, conducted RF, EFT/burst, surge and DC dips on the frozen configuration, with functional monitoring throughout.
tests.responsibleParty: Accredited EMC laboratory (not engaged) + MAREA hardware engineering (not authorised)

tests.purpose: Establish immunity of user-accessible connectors and surfaces to contact and air electrostatic discharge in a dry, cold or synthetic-clothing helm environment.
tests.requirementSource: IEC 61000-4-2:2008 ESD immunity method (EVD-MC11-407); the catalogue page itself notes a 2025 edition replaced it; current edition not retrieved. IEC 60945:2002 as voluntary reference (EVD-MC11-401).
tests.acceptanceCriterion: Candidate: no permanent damage; no reset that loses data or enters an unsafe state; recoverable upset only at the agreed level. Not measured, not achieved.
tests.testMethod: Contact and air discharges at the agreed levels on connectors, enclosure surface and any antenna port; engineering pre-test followed by an accredited test.
tests.responsibleParty: Accredited EMC laboratory (not engaged); in-house pre-test by MAREA (not authorised)

tests.purpose: Establish whether load-dump-style and switching transients on the vessel DC bus and on the field interfaces damage the appliance or propagate between interfaces.
tests.requirementSource: IEC 61000-4-5 surge method (EVD-MC11-408); ISO 7637-2 named candidate practice for a 12 V DC bus, page NOT retrieved and applicability to be confirmed; IEC 60945:2002 as voluntary reference (EVD-MC11-401).
tests.acceptanceCriterion: Candidate: no permanent damage; a defined recovery; no unsafe reset loop; a fault on one interface is contained to that interface. Not measured, not achieved.
tests.testMethod: Surge injection on the DC input and field ports with coupling/decoupling networks; interface fault injection (short to battery, short to ground, open).
tests.responsibleParty: Accredited laboratory (not engaged) + MAREA hardware engineering (not authorised)

tests.purpose: Establish the water-ingress behaviour of the final assembly (enclosure, gasket, cable glands, connectors, service opening) for the installation class chosen at design review.
tests.requirementSource: IEC 60529 IP Code as a CANDIDATE REQUIREMENT only (EVD-MC11-402); no IP digit is chosen and no rating is claimed. Ingress of an assembled unit is not established by the rating of an empty purchased enclosure.
tests.acceptanceCriterion: Candidate: no water entry that impairs function or safety; no standing water at connectors; inspection criteria defined before test. Not tested, no rating.
tests.testMethod: IPX5/IPX6 jet or IPX7/IPX8 immersion test, chosen after installation analysis, on the final assembly; post-test functional test and internal inspection.
tests.responsibleParty: Accredited ingress laboratory (not engaged) + MAREA mechanical engineering (not authorised)

tests.purpose: Establish corrosion behaviour of enclosure, bezel, fasteners and connectors in a salt-laden atmosphere over the intended service environment.
tests.requirementSource: IEC 60068-2-52:2017 cyclic salt mist (EVD-MC11-403); ISO 9227:2022 salt-spray method (EVD-MC11-412). ISO 9227 itself states it is not intended to predict long-term corrosion resistance; interpretation must be product-specific.
tests.acceptanceCriterion: Candidate: no corrosion affecting function, sealing or connector resistance; no fastener seizure; inspection criteria defined before test. Not measured, not achieved.
tests.testMethod: Cyclic salt-mist test on the final assembly and on material coupons; post-test functional test, contact-resistance check and visual inspection against written criteria.
tests.responsibleParty: Accredited corrosion laboratory (not engaged) + MAREA materials engineering (not authorised)

tests.purpose: Establish behaviour under high humidity with condensation (overnight cooling in a locker) and under steady-state damp heat, including insulation resistance and parameter drift.
tests.requirementSource: IEC 60068-2-30:2005 damp heat cyclic (EVD-MC11-406), noting the catalogue page states a 2025 edition replaced it; IEC 60068-2-78:2025 damp heat steady state WITHOUT condensation (EVD-MC11-421). Neither test substitutes for the other.
tests.acceptanceCriterion: Candidate: no condensation-induced leakage, corrosion or functional failure; recovery after cycles; insulation resistance and drift within limits fixed at design review. Not measured, not achieved.
tests.testMethod: Cyclic damp-heat/condensation test plus a steady-state damp-heat soak, with functional checks at defined points.
tests.responsibleParty: Accredited environmental laboratory (not engaged) + MAREA hardware engineering (not authorised)

tests.purpose: Establish operating and storage temperature limits and behaviour, including thermal cycling between extremes, for an appliance installed in a closed locker behind or near the helm.
tests.requirementSource: IEC 60068-2-14:2023 change of temperature (EVD-MC11-420); IEC 60068-2-1/-2-2 named candidate methods whose pages were NOT retrieved; IEC 60945:2002 as voluntary environmental reference (EVD-MC11-401). Candidate voltage/window context in D5 section 1.
tests.acceptanceCriterion: Candidate: declared functions operate within the agreed envelope; honest thermal state; no unsafe state; no temperature claim above the tested envelope. Not measured, no range established.
tests.testMethod: Climatic chamber: cold start, hot operational soak, storage at extremes with recovery, and air-to-air thermal cycling with functional monitoring.
tests.responsibleParty: Accredited environmental laboratory (not engaged) + MAREA hardware engineering (not authorised)

tests.purpose: Establish resistance to sinusoidal vibration and mechanical shock in the installed orientation for a locker-mounted or helm-adjacent appliance.
tests.requirementSource: IEC 60068-2-6:2007 sinusoidal vibration (EVD-MC11-404); IEC 60068-2-27:2008 shock (EVD-MC11-405); IEC 60945:2002 as voluntary reference (EVD-MC11-401); Lloyd's Register Type Approval Test Specification 1 environmental categories as a VOLUNTARY classed-vessel reference only (EVD-MC11-418), not applicable to a recreational craft by default.
tests.acceptanceCriterion: Candidate: no mechanical damage, connector disengagement, solder-joint failure or functional interruption; post-test function passes. Not measured, not achieved.
tests.testMethod: Sinusoidal vibration sweep and endurance on the installed mounting, then shock pulses per the chosen method; functional monitoring during and after.
tests.responsibleParty: Accredited mechanical laboratory (not engaged) + MAREA mechanical engineering (not authorised)

tests.purpose: Establish safe behaviour across DC voltage dips, short interruptions, cranking-style brownouts, reverse polarity and the full candidate input window, including storage-write interruption.
tests.requirementSource: IEC 61000-4-29:2026 DC dips, short interruptions and voltage variations (EVD-MC11-409); IEC 61000-4-11 named candidate for any AC variant whose page was NOT retrieved; D5 section 1 candidate window (9-32 V DC candidate input across 12 V and 24 V systems).
tests.acceptanceCriterion: Candidate: defined safe restart; no storage corruption; no fabricated value; no unsafe state; recovery within a target fixed at design review. Not measured, not achieved.
tests.testMethod: Programmable DC source sweeps and dip/interruption profiles with repeated power cycling; reverse polarity with current limit; write-interruption test.
tests.responsibleParty: MAREA test engineering (not authorised); accredited witnessed test required for formal conformity evidence

tests.purpose: Establish the unintentional emission behaviour of a receive-only receiver appliance so that the EMC route for a radio receiver can be planned.
tests.requirementSource: CISPR 32:2015+A1:2019 emission method (EVD-MC11-410); EMC Directive 2014/30/EU market frame (EVD-MC11-415); RED 2014/53/EU applies to a receiver as radio equipment (EVD-MC11-416). IEC 60945:2002 as voluntary reference (EVD-MC11-401).
tests.acceptanceCriterion: Candidate: no emission above the chosen limit; the receiver's own emissions do not degrade its reception function. Not measured, not achieved.
tests.testMethod: Engineering pre-scan then accredited emissions test on the frozen receiver configuration, including antenna port and cable routing.
tests.responsibleParty: Accredited EMC laboratory (not engaged) + MAREA RF engineering (not authorised)

tests.purpose: Establish whether RF fields from a nearby handheld VHF radio, transients on the vessel bus and conducted RF on the antenna cable upset the receiver or its data output.
tests.requirementSource: IEC 61000-4-5 surge (EVD-MC11-408); CISPR 32 frame (EVD-MC11-410); IEC 61000-4-3/-4/-6 named candidate methods, pages NOT retrieved; RED essential requirements (EVD-MC11-416).
tests.acceptanceCriterion: Candidate: no receiver upset that corrupts or loses targets silently; no permanent damage; recovery behaviour defined. Not measured, not achieved.
tests.testMethod: Accredited immunity campaign with functional monitoring of the receiver's data output during each stress.
tests.responsibleParty: Accredited EMC laboratory (not engaged) + MAREA RF engineering (not authorised)

tests.purpose: Establish ESD immunity at user connectors and at the antenna port of a receive-only receiver.

tests.testMethod: Surge injection on the antenna port with a matching/coupling network; antenna open/short fault simulation.
tests.responsibleParty: Accredited laboratory (not engaged) + MAREA RF engineering (not authorised)

tests.purpose: Establish water-ingress behaviour of the receiver enclosure and antenna connector in the installed location.
tests.requirementSource: IEC 60529 as a CANDIDATE REQUIREMENT only (EVD-MC11-402); no digit chosen and no rating claimed.

tests.purpose: Establish receiver sensitivity, selectivity, blocking, conducted and radiated spurious response against a reference receiver so that no reception claim is made without measurement.
tests.requirementSource: RED 2014/53/EU essential requirements for radio equipment (EVD-MC11-416); service-appropriate radio standards named only as candidates (pages not retrieved). IEC 61162-1 interface family is NOT an RF test standard and is not used here (EVD-MC11-411).
tests.acceptanceCriterion: Candidate: receiver meets an agreed sensitivity/selectivity/spurious envelope; no reception claim is published before this test passes. Not measured, no envelope established.
tests.testMethod: Conducted RF bench measurements with a calibrated signal generator and reference receiver, followed by an accredited RF test.
tests.responsibleParty: Accredited RF laboratory (not engaged) + MAREA RF engineering (not authorised)

tests.purpose: Establish whether the antenna/splitter installation degrades the vessel's required VHF radio and whether reception quality meets the agreed envelope dockside.
tests.requirementSource: IEC 60945:2002 as voluntary reference (EVD-MC11-401); D9 section 1.3 antenna/splitter installation-safety requirement; ITU-R M.1371 named candidate, page NOT retrieved.
tests.acceptanceCriterion: Candidate: splitter insertion loss within an agreed limit; no degradation of the vessel's required VHF radio; receiver meets the agreed dockside reception envelope. Not measured, not achieved.
tests.testMethod: Dockside reference-receiver comparison, splitter insertion-loss measurement and an in-situ radio check.
